name: Gravitational Group Selection
summary: Desktop 3D modelling: click an object and drag to select it together with everything resting on it, using a contact graph built from gravity.
howItWorks: A collision detector builds a contact graph of what supports what. Clicking an object and dragging selects it with all objects it supports; the drag direction (directional dragging) or anchors placed on objects to exclude (anchoring and grouping) decide which side-by-side neighbours join the group. Dragging further moves the whole group.
